import type { CommandSink, MessageSink } from '../../../src/bot/core.js';
import type { ErrorBody } from '../../../src/errors.js';
import { safeText } from '../../../src/safe-text.js';
declare const command: CommandSink;
declare const message: MessageSink;
declare const err: Error;
const accepted1 = command.replyEphemeral(safeText('literal wrapped at its definition'));
const accepted2 = message.reply(safeText('fixed text'), []);
void accepted1;
void accepted2;
command.replyEphemeral(err.message);
const alias = err.message;
command.replyEphemeral(alias);
const { message: destructured } = err;
command.replyEphemeral(destructured);
message.reply(err.message, []);
message.react(err.message);
command.replyEphemeral('a bare literal is not SafeText');
safeText(err.message);
const body: ErrorBody = { error: { code: 'internal_error', message: err.message } };
async function reportFailure(problem: Error, target: MessageSink): Promise<void> {
  await target.reply(problem.message, []);
}
void reportFailure;
void body;
